Daily Devotional

July 27

1 And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins; 2 Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience: (Ephesians 2:1-2 KJV)

The being dead in trespasses and sins means that we were spiritually dead and separated from God. When the word dead is used in the bible it is not always referring to physical death, but refers to the effects of being separated spiritually from God. We were “quickened” or made alive with Jesus (Galatians 4:6), and therefore overcame the spiritual death we were under due to the sins we all were doing (Romans 3:23).

Walking according to the course of this world refers to us being under the control of Satan, as he is the “prince of the power of the air” referred to in the above scripture. Many people don’t have the slightest idea that they are under the control of Satan, as they think they are doing their own thing, but the truth is that if you are not walking in the spirit, following Christ, then you are under the influence of the devil (Romans 6:16). There is not such a thing as a “self-made person”, as we are all either after the spirit, or after the flesh in all we do. Walk after the spirit and let your light shine (Matthew 5:16) to the Glory of God.
